title: Design-crew
description: An agent pipeline I built to re-create the Fleet Console concept: small agents, human gates, and a logged decision at every step.
hmw: re-create a concept under NDA with agents, while I still make every call?

facts.label: My part
facts.value: Designed the pipeline and made every call at the human gates

facts.label: When
facts.value: Built afterward for the Fleet Console re-creation. Not used at Woven.

facts.label: Built on
facts.value: Claude agents (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) reading and writing small files

heroImages.alt: The pipeline: each arrow is a file one agent hands the next, with two human gates.

image.alt: Design-crew pipeline diagram. Brief (designer and Opus) to domain modeler, IA architect, human gate 1, system designer, parallel builders, token linter and UX critic with fix rounds, human gate 2, storyteller, honesty checker, published. Every agent appends to a shared ledger of decisions.md and metrics.md.

blocks.caption: Each arrow is a file one agent hands the next.

blocks.text: Agents pass files, not chat history
Each agent reads a few small files and writes one. A shared ledger of decisions and metrics is the memory.
Two gates where only I decide

cards.label: Gate 1: the IA
cards.value: I chose workflow-first from three IA models, and marked which agent defaults were unconfirmed assumptions.

cards.label: Gate 2: the screens
cards.value: I reviewed prototype screenshots, and my critique drove the second fix round.

items.label: logged agent runs, on one day

blocks.text: Cheap models for volume, people for judgment
Opus and I wrote the brief and made the gate calls; Opus tokens aren't logged.

images.alt: iPhone takeover with Resolve locked after the fix
In-vehicle call with Yes and No keys after the fix
Inbox with every column on screen after the fix

cards.label: Resolve wasn't disabled
cards.value: The button was never passed disabled. It now stays locked, with the reason inline.

cards.label: A question, one answer key
cards.value: “Are you safe?” offered only Done. It now has Yes and No keys.

cards.label: Columns off-screen
cards.value: Status, Owner and Age were clipped. It took three passes to fix the cause.

items: No benchmark against working alone. The numbers measure effort, not quality.
The critic judged static screenshots, and contrast checks cover color only.
The agents invent things. Protocol steps, severity map and timeout are placeholders only a safety owner can check.
